scenario.task:
I want to check if my phone is still covered under warranty and request a replacement if it is

User Guide: The user asks if their phone is still covered. They will verify their identity, confirm the purchase date/status, and proceed with the replacement request once coverage is confirmed If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
